quest.title: A Timeless Classic
quest.description: Gygax from Mondstadt seems to be trying to drum up some interest in his game.

dialogues.speaker: Gygax
dialogues.text: Hey there, fancy trying your hand at Windtrace?

dialogues.speaker: Gygax
dialogues.text: I'm glad you asked. Windtrace is a game that's all about Mondstadt's history!

dialogues.speaker: Gygax
dialogues.text: I suppose you've heard of the aristocrats who once lived in Mondstadt City?

dialogues.speaker: Gygax
dialogues.text: They were tyrants, and their rule was brutal. Words cannot do justice to the way that people suffered at their hands...

dialogues.speaker: Gygax
dialogues.text: To fight back against their oppression, a group of brave citizens came together and formed an underground resistance.

dialogues.speaker: Gygax
dialogues.text: These valiant rebels engaged in operations throughout the city, becoming a major thorn in the side of the aristocrats.

dialogues.speaker: Gygax
dialogues.text: But the aristocrats retaliated, quickly training up their own team of henchmen to suppress the rebels.

dialogues.speaker: Gygax
dialogues.text: And so, the rebels fought duel after duel with the aristocrats' lackeys all across Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Gygax
dialogues.text: Windtrace takes its inspiration from this thrilling chapter of Mondstadt's history! And it used to be quite popular, too...

dialogues.speaker: Gygax
dialogues.text: Sadly, yes. Young people these days don't seem very interested in the game...

dialogues.speaker: Gygax
dialogues.text: But I can't let Windtrace fade into obscurity. So, I tweaked the rules a little to make it easier to get into and more fun.

dialogues.speaker: Gygax
dialogues.text: I also added a whole load of brand-new maps in. Hopefully, this will help to attract more people...

dialogues.speaker: Gygax
dialogues.text: Heh. But don't take my word for it — try it out for yourself!

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: Alright, well, if you're ever interested to try it out, you know where to find me.
